title: Otelde oda almak
situation: You arrive at a hotel late in the evening. You booked a room last week.
situationTr: Otele akşam geç saatte varıyorsun. Geçen hafta bir oda ayırtmıştın.
prompts: Give your name and say you have a booking.
Ask if there is an elevator.
Say you would like a quiet room.
promptsTr: Adını söyle ve rezervasyonun olduğunu belirt.

usefulPhrases.en: I have a booking for two nights.
What time does breakfast start?
Is there an elevator to the third floor?
Could I have a quiet room, please?
usefulPhrases.tr: Sessiz bir oda alabilir miyim lütfen?

usefulPhrases.en: What time must I leave the room?

title: Geçen yaz tatili
situation: A friend asks about your holiday last summer. Talk about where you went and what you did.
situationTr: Bir arkadaşın geçen yazki tatilini soruyor. Nereye gittiğini ve ne yaptığını anlat.
prompts: Where did you go and who with?

usefulPhrases.en: We went to the coast for a week.
We traveled by train.
The weather was hot and sunny.
The best part was the food.
I would like to go again.

title: Kıyafet değiştirmek
situation: You bought a shirt yesterday but it is too small. Go back to the shop.
situationTr: Dün bir gömlek aldın ama çok küçük geldi. Dükkâna geri dön.
prompts: Show that you have the receipt.
Ask about getting your money back.

usefulPhrases.en: I bought this yesterday but it is too small.
usefulPhrases.tr: Bunu dün aldım ama çok küçük geldi.

usefulPhrases.en: Do you have a bigger size?
Here is the receipt.
Can I have my money back?
Can I try it on?

title: Bir arkadaşı davet etmek
situation: You want to invite a friend to your birthday dinner on Saturday.
situationTr: Cumartesi günkü doğum günü yemeğine bir arkadaşını davet etmek istiyorsun.
prompts: Invite your friend and say when.
Answer if your friend cannot come.
promptsTr: Arkadaşını davet et ve zamanı söyle.

usefulPhrases.en: Would you like to come to my birthday dinner?
usefulPhrases.tr: Doğum günü yemeğime gelmek ister misin?

usefulPhrases.en: It is at eight on Saturday.
It is at the restaurant near the station.
Do not worry, we can meet another time.
usefulPhrases.tr: Merak etme, başka bir zaman buluşuruz.

usefulPhrases.en: Let me know by Thursday.

title: Otobüste unutulan çanta
situation: You left your bag on the bus. Report it at the bus station office.
situationTr: Çantanı otobüste unuttun. Otogardaki ofiste bildir.
promptsTr: Ne olduğunu ve ne zaman olduğunu söyle.

usefulPhrases.en: I left my bag on the bus this morning.
It is black and quite small.
There were some books inside.
Could you call me if you find it?
My number is on this paper.

title: Doktordan randevu almak
situation: You telephone the health center to make an appointment for this week.
situationTr: Bu hafta için randevu almak üzere sağlık ocağını arıyorsun.
prompts: Say who you are and why you are calling.
Say which days you are free.
Ask how long the visit takes.
promptsTr: Kim olduğunu ve neden aradığını söyle.

usefulPhrases.en: I would like to make an appointment.
I am free on Tuesday afternoon.
How long does it take?
Should I bring anything?
Could you say that again, please?

title: İki şehri karşılaştırmak
situation: You have lived in two cities. Compare them for a friend who wants to move.
situationTr: İki şehirde yaşadın. Taşınmak isteyen bir arkadaşın için ikisini karşılaştır.
prompts: Which is cheaper to live in?
Which do you prefer and why?

usefulPhrases.en: The first city is much bigger.
Life is cheaper in the second one.
The buses are better there.
I prefer the smaller city.
It is quieter and I have more friends there.
usefulPhrases.tr: Daha sakin ve orada daha çok arkadaşım var.

title: Restoranda sorun
situation: You are in a restaurant. Your food is cold and you waited a long time.
situationTr: Bir restoranadasın. Yemeğin soğuk ve uzun süre bekledin.
prompts: Say what you would like them to do.

usefulPhrases.en: Excuse me, could you help me?
I am afraid this food is cold.
We waited for forty minutes.
Could you bring a hot one, please?
Could we have the bill, please?

title: Yeni bir iş
situation: You started a new job last month. A friend asks how it is going.
situationTr: Geçen ay yeni bir işe başladın. Bir arkadaşın nasıl gittiğini soruyor.
prompts: Say what you like about it.

usefulPhrases.en: I work in an office near the park.
I start at nine and finish at six.
The people there are very friendly.
The hardest thing is the early mornings.
I think I will stay.

title: Gelecek yıl planların
situation: Your teacher asks about your plans for next year. Talk about what you want to do.
situationTr: Öğretmenin gelecek yılki planlarını soruyor. Ne yapmak istediğini anlat.
prompts: Say what you are going to study or do.
Say where you want to live.
Say what you want to learn.
Say what might change your plan.
promptsTr: Ne okuyacağını ya da yapacağını söyle.

usefulPhrases.en: I am going to study computers.
I hope to live in a bigger city.
usefulPhrases.tr: Daha büyük bir şehirde yaşamayı umuyorum.

usefulPhrases.en: I want to learn to drive.
If I do not pass the exam, I will wait a year.
I am not sure yet.
